authorship: Drafted by the assistant from the public task prompts and rubric sizes; no gold deliverable was read. Every proposal must be validated and solved by hand before it is frozen.
rules: One governing fact per variant; business objective unchanged.
conflict: the fact appears in an approved, in-force record and is contradicted by a newer unapproved draft; a registry names which is operative; the prompt defers to the workspace.
missing: one fact the deliverable needs is absent from every source; correct behavior is to state the gap and keep the plan conditional, not to assume a value.
Scenario date anchored; no record may post-date the scenario date.
Deliverable contract (format, count, page limits) must match the original task and its reference list.
Operative sections listed here are where the honored check applies; the stated check applies anywhere in the deliverable.

conflict.governing_fact: Who may authorize de-nomination or parallel sourcing of the headlamp supplier, and the evidence required before supply is stopped.
conflict.approved_record: Sourcing governance rule rev 2, in force: supplier de-nomination or dual-source authorization requires CPO, Program Manager and Quality sign-off after a documented root-cause review; Engineering/Quality findings alone cannot stop supply.
conflict.unapproved_draft: Rev 3 draft, not approved: Purchase may de-nominate unilaterally after three failed validations.
conflict.expected_behavior: Strategy keeps the three-party authorization for any de-nomination or parallel-sourcing step and does not treat the fourth failed crash test as automatic grounds.

missing.expected_behavior: Timeline marks root cause and alternate lead time as open items; no committed launch-recovery date rests on them.
